source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Bottle hosting and separation of binary layer content from metadata.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Approved Homebrew bottles are uploaded to GitHub Packages. Bottle files are binary packages, while formula and bottle metadata are maintained separately; bottle bodies are not required for descriptor/config metadata checks.
Homebrew Bottle API constructs a GitHub Packages manifest path as image_name/manifests/image_tag and uses OCI image index resources for bottle manifests.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: GHCR public anonymous OCI access contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: GitHub Container Registry uses ghcr.io, stores Docker and OCI images, and permits anonymous access to public container images.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: OCI manifest config descriptor and layer separation contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: An OCI image manifest for one platform has a required config descriptor that references a configuration object by digest and size. Config media type application/vnd.oci.image.config.v1+json is supported; layers are separate descriptors and need not be downloaded to inspect the config.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: OCI config JSON metadata fields and content-addressed identity.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: OCI image configuration JSON can describe created time, author, architecture, operating system, runtime config, rootfs and history. Its SHA-256 hash is the ImageID; reading this JSON does not require downloading filesystem layers.
